title: Ordo Lucis
opening: For a thousand years the bells of Civitas Lucis have rung at dawn.
The Order of Light kept the gates, and the gates held.
The sins of the world took shape, and they came for the city.
Most knights were sent to the walls. A few were sent to the road.
You are the newest of the Order, and the least proven.
Light does not ask who is ready. It asks who will go.
pathIntro: The Order calls three kinds of souls to its work...
the Miles, who stands where others fall
the Venator, who hunts what hides
and the Peregrinus, who walks where there is no road.
